svg.title: 共享核心 面对三类工作负载 / A Shared Core Under Three Workloads
svg.desc: 各领域配置定义任务约束，客户配置再承载具体组织的权限和责任。 Domain profiles encode the workload. Customer profiles add organization-specific authority and accountability.
